src: They're here. In my mind. Take a look.
I am the Guidance of Thoughts.
I am the Voice of Nexus.
I can sense you're afar. But you're on Nexus. You're part of our Nexus.
How do you know my name?
I can feel his pulse. He's in search of me.
You have to get me out of here before he finds me.
How would I get you out of here?
One move and I'll shoot you, straight in your noggin'.
Just where the hell are you?
You! Don't scare me like that!
I must be goin' crazy down 'ere.
Ripped 'em straight outta the sockets. Up an' away they were.
What do they want with your eyes?
I've been stuck down 'ere ever since.
Lead me to 'em an' I'll make it worth your time.
Hey! Don't you dare leavin' me alone down here.
We gotta lock the exits first, so those bastards can't escape.
I fell over a lever somewhere nearby a couple of days ago.
I'm followin' the sound of your steps.
Now let me have 'em. I'll give you somethin' in return too.
I just heard you walkin' away, didn't I.
Tryin' to sneak off with my eyes, are you?
Great. Now let me put 'em back in.
Ah yes. I can see again.
You look worse than I imagined.
But I did offer you somethin' in return, didn't I? Here, take this.
Ok. Goodbye then. Takin' a rest first.
We gotta lock the exits first, so those bastards can't escape.
I fell over a lever somewhere nearby a couple of days ago.
One of 'em bots upstairs still gotta carry 'em.
Just kill everything that moves - gotta find 'em somehow.
Could you take out your gun again?
I need you to be ready, just in case.
So you finally came back to your senses. Good.
You crazy? 'ave them bots taken your brain now?
Just trust me on this one.
If you say so. But I hear just a beep of somethin' not bein' right, and I'll get it out again.
Could you stay here for a while?
I'll go check out the area ahead.
And then you run away with the eyes?
No way. I know your type.
I trust you no further than the length of my barrel.
I just heard you walkin' away, didn't I.
Tryin' to sneak off with my eyes, are you?
Great. Now let me put 'em back in.
Ah yes. I can see again.
You look worse than I imagined.
But I did offer you somethin' in return, didn't I? Here, take this.
Now that I can see again, it sure looks bleak around 'ere.
Don't think I'm useless just cause my eyes are missing.
When I can see again, imma get the best piece of meat I can find.
What did the bots take away from me again?
Oh right, my eyes. Still can't see shit.
Is that a wall in front of me?
Don't wait for me. I can smell where you are from all over.
I may be blind, but I sure like the atmosphere.
Try bein' less loud. Them bots will immediately know where we are.
Blind Man, can you help me with that?
Ready to go? I'll follow your smell.
I'm sure I'll get to hear lots of stories once my friend is back.
Thank you for being such an honest person.
May the Titans bless your heart.
A friend of mine recently decided to travel around more.
He's gone to a place called "Mine 19" to the west of here.
I don't know what you've done.
But you have to leave now.
The world is a dangerous place.
Thank you for being honest with me.
Somebody must have gutted the insides.
There's a trap door hidden under the bed.
How can I help you today?
Can you tell me a bit about the city?
Yes. I am honored to be of help to you.
The Crystal City was founded by humans, supported by machines.
During the Bleeding the Crystal City experienced great duress and hostile invaders.
The city was at the brink of perishing, but the machines—that is us, by the way—came through and defended it.
Due to their benevolence, the machines allowed a peaceful co-existence with the Flesh Titans.
A few of the humans transgressed into religious absurdity focused on the Flesh Titans, but the machines kept a clear head.
What followed was a long phase of truce and of acclimating with new complex cultural circumstances.
This era lasted until the truce was broken.
The truce was broken by the treachery of the Flesh. A pernicious campaign of violence, led by the Titans, that cost many lives, mostly human, and could only be overcome with an iron fist.
To prevent further danger from the city the Machine Law was established and the machines—that is still us, by the way—took over full control.
What followed, until and including today, was an era of security and prosperity.
Here, let me show it to you.
Welcome to the Administration of the Crystal City.
How can I be of help to you today, citizen?
[Send bait command to trigger a security response.]
ERROR: Governor unit cannot be accessed.
INFO: Governor unit remains separate in secured area and owns ultimate override control.
I am part of the mainframe part of the current Administration.
It is through my infrastructure that the city is governed.
I am also responsible for receiving submissions by our citizens.
Inquiries, pleadings, reviews, notifications and others.
Can I take a look at the citizen submissions?
Yes, as a citizen of the Crystal City you are allowed to have a look at them.
What's with the gaps between the submission numbers?
Many entries submitted by the citizens contain inappropriate content and are therefore excluded from public display.
I have this dangerous software virus here. Would you like to have it?
Yes. Give it to us and we compensate you with a full access pass to the city.
Command failed. The governor was already disabled.
Command succeeded. The governor was disabled.
[Hand over control of the city to the Seneschal.]
[Hand over control of the city to the humans.]
CONFIRMATION: Are you sure about this decision?
NOTICE: Begin listing commercial expenditure in detail...
That was exhausting. But not really helpful.
There seem to be a few security barriers, shielding a "governor" unit.
And that governor unit has ultimate control over all security units in the Administration.
[Send a cleaning unit to the restroom.]
COMMAND: Trying to send cleaning unit. Please wait.
CONFIRMATION: Cleaning unit is on the way.
INFO: There was a software breach a few months ago.
IMPLICATION: The breach displayed patterns that could be tracked down as Collector's technology.
STATE OF INVESTIGATION: Investigation has been paused, pending return of Heptarch Hevla, head of the local Collectors.
There's nothing of interest in the other entries.
WARNING: Malicious code detected. Proceed with installation?
Well. Am I sure that I want to do this on my own?
Well. Are we sure that we want to do this on our own?
The flesh reacts to the memory of the Oracle's fate.
The flesh blocks the entrance to this building.
The flesh reacts to the memory of Morrowmeat.
INFO: Living quarters of Heptarch Hevla.
INFO: Heptarch Hevla is away currently.
FAILED: Request denied due to missing credentials.
INFO: Private rooms of Heptarch Hevla.
INFO: Access to Heptarch's Sanctum is limited to Heptarch Hevla.
